name: promo-tile
title: Promo tile
description: A promotional tile for a product grid: a picture, a short headline and one action, one or two columns wide, with words on a solid plate.
docs: Put it in a grid next to product cards and add grid-flow-dense to the grid, so a wide tile never leaves a gap. span={2} applies from the sm breakpoint up; on a phone every tile is one column, and it fits its own track whether the grid has one column there or two. The picture is decorative unless you give it alt text, and a screen reader hears "Promotion" first.
